description: Page-specific objection map, required evidence, and placement strategy for the Rank Kiwi website.

objections.response: Rank Kiwi is a free Chrome extension that benchmarks public Instagram Reels and YouTube videos against creator typical performance to reveal viral outliers.
objections.evidenceType: Product video + 3-step workflow carousel + UI screenshots

objections.objection: Is Rank Kiwi free or a trial?
objections.response: 100% free forever ($0/mo). No credit card, no subscription, no hidden tiers.
objections.evidenceType: Transparent Pricing Card with feature checklist

objections.objection: Do I need to give you my social media login or password?
objections.response: Never. Rank Kiwi requires no account and never asks for passwords. It only inspects public DOM elements rendered in your active browser session.
objections.evidenceType: Privacy Architecture Grid & Privacy Policy link

objections.objection: Does it actually work on Instagram Reels without breaking?
objections.response: Yes, Rank Kiwi works on creator profile grids and the dedicated Reels tab, extracting public views, likes, comments, and captions in real-time.
objections.evidenceType: Authentic UI screenshots of Instagram Reels grid with Outlier Score badges

objections.objection: Can I export findings to Google Sheets or Excel?
objections.response: Yes, with one click you can export full post tables (dates, view counts, outlier multipliers, captions, and links) to CSV, JSON, or direct clipboard copy.

objections.objection: Does it work on YouTube Shorts as well as long-form videos?
objections.response: Yes. Rank Kiwi natively parses both long-form channel uploads and the dedicated /shorts tab, calculating separate median baselines.
objections.evidenceType: Surface comparison table and YouTube UI screenshot

objections.objection: How is Outlier Score calculated, and why not use averages?
objections.response: Average view count is heavily skewed by a single mega-hit post. Rank Kiwi uses the creator's median benchmark: Outlier Score = Post Views / Median Views. A 3.2× score means the post earned more than triple typical performance.
objections.evidenceType: Mathematical breakdown, worked creator examples, and visual distribution diagram

objections.objection: Why choose Rank Kiwi over big tools like Socialinsider or Metricool?
objections.response: Rank Kiwi isn't built for enterprise client reporting ($99–$200+/mo). It is built for fast, lightweight creator content research directly in the browser with zero login friction and zero cost.
objections.evidenceType: Objective feature comparison tables, pricing comparisons, and 'When to choose which' guidelines

objections.objection: Is this actually a replacement for my current workflow tool?
objections.response: Transparently shows what Rank Kiwi replaces (in-browser feed sorting, outlier scoring, quick CSV exports) and what it doesn't (multi-account scheduling, paid ad tracking).
objections.evidenceType: Use-case fit matrix and transparent trade-offs

objections.objection: Is this just an affiliate listicle ranking the highest paying tool #1?
objections.response: Rank Kiwi accepts no affiliate commissions or sponsored rankings. First-place recommendations are awarded strictly on genuine merit (e.g. YouTube Studio for owned channel retention).
objections.evidenceType: Editorial methodology disclosure, evaluation criteria table, and transparent trade-offs

objections.objection: Is this research marketing fluff or real empirical data?
objections.response: All research studies are based on peer-reviewed methodology, public datasets (e.g. vidIQ 448k channel dataset, Kaggle 10k Instagram dataset), and cite clear sample sizes, medians, and confidence intervals.
objections.evidenceType: Interactive methodology links, data tables, distribution histograms, and reproducible research notes

objections.objection: What if the extension doesn't appear or stops working?
objections.response: The complete Troubleshooting Hub provides a diagnostic decision tree and actionable fixes for common issues (surface mismatches, browser updates, infinite scrolling pauses).
objections.evidenceType: Interactive diagnostic decision tree + 5 dedicated troubleshooting guides
